# peakst8 product notes

> Product notes for peakst8 features: who each feature is for, the screens and the timeline to go live.

## peakst8 Embedded Ticketing

> peakst8 Embedded Ticketing lets run clubs and fitness communities sell events on their own website. Event pages are server-rendered on the club's domain with Event and FAQ schema, so they rank on Google and get cited by AI answer engines. peakst8 runs checkout, payments, refunds and check-in.

- [Product note](https://peakst8-basecamp.github.io/product-notes/embedded-ticketing/): ICP and pilots, the problem, Cubbon Classic 10K case study, launch-to-scale path, SEO and AEO requirements, architecture, V1 scope, timeline, FAQ, open questions
- [Prototype](https://peakst8-basecamp.github.io/product-notes/embedded-ticketing/prototype/): clickable V1 screens (admin A1, organiser O1–O7, attendee E1–E6, club registration C1–C3) with states and build notes

## Run Crew × peakst8 Playbook

> Reebok training plan rollout: about 250 Run Crew runners moving onto the peakst8 app.

- [Product note](https://peakst8-basecamp.github.io/product-notes/run-crew/): why, team, roster, app setup, install, onboarding and weekly messages, Reebok review
- [App screens](https://peakst8-basecamp.github.io/product-notes/run-crew/app-screens/): every app screen, journey by journey
- [Install guide](https://peakst8-basecamp.github.io/product-notes/run-crew/install-guide/): how runners install the peakst8 app on Android and iPhone
## peakst8 Club Memberships

> Clubs sell recurring memberships and prepaid packs on peakst8. Members book each run, class or event as usual, and peakst8 applies the plan at checkout so the ticket is free, discounted or uses one credit. Recurring plans bill through Razorpay Subscriptions with UPI AutoPay.

- [Product note](https://peakst8-basecamp.github.io/product-notes/memberships/): concepts, member and host flows, plan lifecycle, checkout pricing, payments, data model, API, scope, open questions, SweatPals evidence
- [Working prototype](https://peakst8-basecamp.github.io/product-notes/memberships/prototype/): member and host screens in the peakst8 app design, with live plan pricing, renewals and host actions
- [Feature list](https://peakst8-basecamp.github.io/product-notes/memberships/coverage/): what members and club admins can do with memberships, by phase: renewal reminders before launch, perks and brand offers, discounts, plans, joining, booking, cancelling

## Athlete OS · Design Partner #2: Cubbon Classic 10K

> Athlete OS Design Partner #2 (Design Partner #1 is Run Crew × Reebok). Event organisers sell entries on their own website with peakst8 checkout and run a race-season engagement layer (weekly missions, points, leaderboards, rewards, nudges) from one peakst8 dashboard. Design partner: Cubbon Classic 10K (Edition 2, 21 March 2027) with Nitin Gowda of MyRace.

- [Product note](https://peakst8-basecamp.github.io/product-notes/athlete-os-cubbon-classic/): board summary, problem, Road to Cubbon Classic programme and scoring, November plan, release checklist, onboarding the organiser, metrics, what carries over from Yoska, risks, open questions
- [Product screens](https://peakst8-basecamp.github.io/product-notes/athlete-os-cubbon-classic/prototype/): organiser dashboard (event home, registration and embed, programme builder, missions, leaderboards, rewards, nudges, clubs, insights) and runner app screens

- [Status of every note](https://peakst8-basecamp.github.io/product-notes/notes.json)
